in_marathi.name: Ikshan
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God's vision, insight
in_marathi.long_meaning: Ikshan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Ikshan is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'Iksh', meaning 'vision' or 'sight'. This name is believed to signify divine vision and insight. In Hindu mythology, Ikshan is an epithet for various gods, particularly Shiva, signifying his all-knowing, omniscient nature.
